product_code_list.title: Product code list (space-joined)
product_code_list.description: A clause applies to several products; arrays cannot be indexed — space-joined string, indexed analysed text (contract artefact 2 limits.L4). Matches the recordload example job at records-service/tools/recordload/examples/clause-library.json's product_code_list column — FLAGGED: that example currently maps the CSV column with `"as":"list"`, which produces a JSON array in the payload, not the space-joined string this field's index declaration needs. The mapping needs a join transform (or `"as":"string"` with pre-joined CSV data) before a real load; wave 1 declares the shape only.
